Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1376 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our client, Brandon Knight, was lawfully traveling in the right lane when your insured changed lanes without signaling
or checking the blind spot. The vehicles made contact, pushing our client's car sideways and forcing it against the
guardrail. The collision was entirely caused by your insured's failure to yield and keep a proper lookout, and the police
report and photographs taken at the scene confirm the point of impact on our client's driver-side rear quarter panel.
As a result of the collision on 5-29-24, our client suffered a significant back strain. Immediately after the impact, our
client experienced sharp lower back pain radiating into the left leg, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Treatment
has included emergency evaluation, imaging, prescribed medication, and a course of physical therapy. Our client has
missed substantial time from work and continues to experience limitations in daily activities.
Liability in this matter is clear. Under the applicable traffic laws, a driver changing lanes must ensure the move can be
made safely, and your insured did not. We therefore request that your company tender payment of $125,000.00 to
resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we
do not receive a satisafctory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Melanie Munoz, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Carlos Fox
Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
